scripts.setup: npm ci && npm --prefix ../tools ci && npm --prefix ../api ci
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run build:tools && npm run build:agent && npm run build:chat
scripts.deploy: npm run setup && npm run build && cdk deploy --require-approval never --outputs-file cdk-outputs.json && npm run frontend:config
scripts.deploy:frontend-aws: npm run setup && npm run build && npm run build:frontend && cdk deploy -c frontendHosting=true --require-approval never --outputs-file cdk-outputs.json
